meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 安装后，当用户提供本地文件路径时，Claude会在容器内用工具把Word、演示文稿、表格、PDF等附件转成Markdown，并给出转换后的文件路径，不会上传到外部解析器。
howto.when: 当消息里带有本地附件路径、需要读取该文件时触发，例如给出Word、PDF、CSV等文件的路径。

say.note: 转换在本地完成，输出Markdown路径。

say.text: 把本地PDF转成Markdown后给我看内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, when the user provides a local file path, Claude converts attachments such as Word, presentations, spreadsheets, or PDFs into Markdown inside the container and returns the converted file path, without uploading to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message includes a local attachment path that must be read, e.g., a Word, PDF, or CSV file path.

say_en.text: Convert this Word attachment to Markdown.
say_en.note: Conversion happens locally; output path is returned.

say_en.text: Convert this local PDF to Markdown and show me the content.
say_en.note: It reads the PDF and produces Markdown.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV file to Markdown.
say_en.note: It recognizes the CSV format and outputs Markdown.
